test_sparse_global_pruning: test the sparse global pruning strategy on a CIFAR ResNet-20 model with 20% pruning fraction
test_iterative_pruning: test iterative sparse global pruning to verify previously pruned weights remain pruned across rounds
test_prune_layers_to_ignore: test sparse global pruning with specific layers excluded from pruning via the layers_to_ignore parameter
test_get_pruning_hparams: test that Strategy.get_pruning_hparams returns the correct PruningHparams subclass for sparse global pruning
test_prune_mask_shapes: test that pruning masks match the tensor shapes of all prunable layers in the model
